description: This file defines the SupabaseService class which provides static methods to access the Supabase client and perform table queries in a Flutter application.

classes.name: SupabaseService
classes.description: A utility class providing static access to the Supabase client and query builder.

methods.name: client
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SupabaseClient configured in SupabaseConfig.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Returns a PostgrestFilterBuilder to facilitate querying a specific table.
